_comment: Manually-curated deals you spot in-store that the automated sources (Flipp weekly ad + web index) miss — e.g. 'buy 2+' member promos. These are merged into every run (lower price wins) so they persist across scrapes. Remove an entry when the deal ends, or set 'expires' (ISO date) to auto-drop it. 'stores' is optional (omit/null = all stores).
